name: WikiLMS
author: devthrow

sections.description:
WikiLMS is a simple and flexible Learning Management System plugin designed to transform your WordPress website into an interactive online learning platform.

It allows educators, trainers, and businesses to create, manage, and deliver courses efficiently using a clean and user-friendly interface.

Features

  • Page builder compatibility
  • Create unlimited courses
  • Simple and lightweight interface
  • Contact form integration via shortcode
  • Course meta fields (Price, Duration, Skill Level, Max Students, Course Access, Language)
sections.installation:
From WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “WikiLMS”
  3. Install and activate the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload it via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Activate the plugin
sections.faq:
What is WikiLMS?

WikiLMS is a WordPress LMS plugin that allows you to build and manage online courses easily.

Is WikiLMS free?

Yes, WikiLMS is completely free to use.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes, WikiLMS works with Elementor and other page builders.

How do I add a contact form?

You can use a Contact Form 7 shortcode and paste the form ID in the course settings.
